title: Paid Time Off (PTO) Accrual
content: Full-time employees accrue 15 days of PTO in their first year of employment. PTO accrues at a rate of 1.25 days per month. Unused PTO rolls over to the next calendar year up to a maximum of 30 days.

title: Remote Work Guidelines
content: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days a week. Core working hours are 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM in the employee's local timezone. A dedicated, quiet workspace is required.

title: Password Rotation Policy
content: All corporate network passwords must be changed every 90 days. Passwords must be at least 14 characters long, containing a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters. Previous 5 passwords cannot be reused.

title: VPN Access and Usage
content: Access to internal corporate servers requires an active VPN connection using the Cisco AnyConnect client. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) via Duo Security is mandatory for all VPN connections.

title: Travel and Expense Policy
content: Employees are granted a daily per diem of $75 for domestic travel and $120 for international travel. Flights exceeding 6 hours are eligible for Premium Economy upgrades. All expenses over $25 require an itemized receipt.

title: Corporate Credit Card Usage
content: Corporate cards are issued to Directors and above. Cards are strictly for business use. Personal purchases made on the corporate card will result in immediate suspension of the card and disciplinary action.

title: Office Access and Badging
content: Employees must wear their ID badges visibly at all times while on company premises. Tailgating through security turnstiles is strictly prohibited. Lost badges must be reported to physical security within 24 hours.

title: Anti-Bribery and Corruption
content: Employees may not offer, give, or accept gifts valued over $100 from vendors, clients, or government officials. All gifts must be logged in the centralized compliance registry within 5 business days.
